title: 67-year-old man hit and killed after driver loses control leaving car wash
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
67-year-old man hit and killed after driver loses control leaving car wash

A 67-year-old man died after a driver lost control and hit him at Whistle Espress Car Wash in Charleston, South Carolina.

Actual Article Body:
CHARLESTON, S.C. (WCSC/Gray News) — A 67-year-old man was killed after being hit at a car wash Sunday.

Around 10:45 a.m., a driver leaving the car wash tunnel lost control of their vehicle and hit John Ganter in the Whistle Espress Car Wash parking lot on Savannah Highway in Charleston, South Carolina.

Charleston Police Department and Charleston Fire Department responded to the scene.

Ganter was taken to a hospital where he later died.

The car wash was closed while investigators processed and documented the scene.

No charges have been filed.
